recipe.visualDefinition: A mirrored studio portrait featuring a central symmetrical axis where two identical figures face outward, their outstretched arms and flowing mesh fabric meeting in the center to form a butterfly-like silhouette against a desaturated teal-grey gradient.
coreVisualRelationships: Horizontal symmetry across the vertical center line
High-contrast lighting defining muscularity and fabric texture
Wide-spaced typography anchoring the top third of the frame
Tension between the dark apparel and the neutral, atmospheric background
coreInvariants: Dynamic, athletic stance with bent knees
Wide letter-spacing in the display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two full-body figures mirrored at the center, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The point where the hands and fabric meet in the center of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central junction, move outward along the arms to the faces, then upward to the wide-spaced text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space at the top and sides to emphasize the central silhouette.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and blonde hair highlights
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the subject's highlights and the dark clothing.

composition.relationshipToImage: floating in negative space above the subjects

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with extreme tracking to create a rhythmic horizontal bar.

candidateDirections.reason: Clean geometric structure matches the modern aesthetic.
Classic geometric proportions provide a timeless pop look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a woman in black athletic gear and a mesh cape, mirrored vertically to create a symmetrical butterfly shape. The background is a smooth gradient of desaturated teal and grey with a subtle floor shadow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase geometric sans-serif text at the top center. Use extreme tracking so the letters span the width of the subjects below. Set the color to pure white.

verificationChecks: Is the symmetry perfect across the vertical axis?
Is the tracking on the text wide enough to feel airy?
Is the background color desaturated and cool-toned?

postGenerationChecks: Check for anatomical anomalies at the mirror seam
Verify the mesh fabric creates a coherent shape in the center
Confirm the lighting is consistent on both mirrored sides
recipe.reuseFormula: Mirror a dynamic studio portrait along a central axis and anchor the composition with wide-tracked, uppercase geometric sans-serif type in the upper negative space.
